narration: There's a rule buried in the tax code that lets you give your kids $19,000 this year, completely tax-free. No forms, no lawyers, no catch — and 95% of Americans have never heard of it.
visual: Tax document SVG with lines of text, large '95%' springs in with amber color, '$19,000 TAX FREE' revealed in amber box at bottom

narration: Here's the thing — when you die with over $13 million, the IRS legally takes 40 cents of every dollar above that. Wealthy families spend fortunes trying to get around it. But there's a legal shortcut hiding in plain sight.
visual: Two animated bar charts side by side: 'YOUR FAMILY KEEPS' in amber growing tall, 'IRS TAKES 40%' in red growing next to it, threshold label '$13 MILLION' appears below

narration: It's called the annual gift tax exclusion. Number one rule you need to know: give any person up to $19,000 per year — zero taxes, zero paperwork. The IRS literally put this loophole in the code themselves.
visual: SVG gift box with lid that springs open upward revealing '$19,000' inside, then three bullet rows fade in: 'ZERO TAXES', 'ZERO PAPERWORK', 'ZERO LIMITS'

narration: If you're married, you each get your own $19,000 limit. So a couple can give each child $38,000 per year, completely tax-free. Got three kids? That's $114,000 walking out of your estate every single year.
visual: Two adult person silhouettes on left with '$19K each' labels, arrow pointing to three smaller child silhouettes on right, '$38,000 per child' box and '$114,000/year total' highlighted in amber

narration: Do this for 20 years and you've moved $2.28 million completely outside your estate. At the 40% tax rate, you just saved your family $912,000 — from a loophole the IRS wrote themselves.
visual: 20 amber bars grow one by one like a bar chart, animated counter counting up to '$2.28M MOVED', then savings counter reveals '$912K SAVED FROM TAXES'

narration: Start this holiday season — write a check or bank transfer to each of your kids. They don't pay taxes on it, you don't file anything. It's the simplest wealth-transfer move that exists. Follow for more.
visual: SVG Christmas tree with gift box underneath, two numbered step cards: '1. WRITE A CHECK OR TRANSFER' and '2. NO TAXES. NO FORMS. DONE.', dark CTA box at bottom: 'FOLLOW FOR MONEY MOVES THE IRS WON'T TELL YOU ABOUT'
